license_claim: CC BY4.0 per publisher; provenance not independently certified
hypothesis: B2B underdogs against rested opponents cover the consensus closing half-point spread more often than the52.380952% hypothetical-110 break-even rate.
population: 2024-25 regular-season source rows. Exclude all December2024 candidate games because source omits six NBA Cup knockout games, which can corrupt rest reconstruction; first appearance for each team unavailable. Do not count postseason.
rest: From previous source-listed game for each exact team ID, with previous game strictly earlier. B2B consecutive America/New_York calendar dates AND18<=elapsed tip-to-tip hours<=36. Opponent elapsed>=48h. No roster/model fitting.
selection: Exactly one B2B team versus rested opponent; B2B team must have positive handicap at close. Half-point main spreads only. One observation per game. No probability60%/40% model claim.
secondary: Always fade the B2B team in the same rest-eligible half-point population, regardless favorite status; descriptive comparator only. Never select a winning variant after results.
grading: Recompute margin+handicap from final scores including overtime; cross-check publisher ATS labels separately. Wins/losses/pushes; no individual-book execution or historical ROI claim.
report: ATS record, Wilson95% interval, N, exclusions and data SHA256. Report hypothetical flat1unit P&L at-110 only as sensitivity, not actual-price profitability. No confirmatory p-value or promotion; one season, missing December coverage, team/week dependence and publisher provenance limitations.
stop: Malformed dates/scores/duplicate IDs or contradictory publisher ATS labels fail audit rather than silently repair. Unavailable exact prices/time prevent registeredT-60 model evaluation. No alternative filters after results.
unseen_status: Row-level outcomes not downloaded before registration; aggregate dataset-card summaries already seen. This is exploratory, not an untouched confirmatory holdout.
primary_model_boundary: Separate from nba-b2b-rest-spread-v1;2024-25 now explicitly inspected development/descriptive evidence.2025-26 and prospective observations not evaluated here.
